package bodyplan
namespace bodyplan

entity Integer id "bodyplan://entity/integer"
entity Boolean id "bodyplan://entity/boolean"

activity AdjustBalance(Integer) -> Integer computes "let result = (input + 3)\nif (input < 0) {\n\tresult = (result - 1)\n} else {\n\tresult = (result + 1)\n}\nreturn result"
